tables_1.title:
PART - II

(Brief details of observations made during post-external cleaning examination and repairs/remedial actions taken be highlighted against each serial in this part. Defects/deficiencies remaining outstanding since last examination be also indicated against relevant serials).

cells.value: Read - Steam/ water drums, Water wall/ super heater/ economizer headers Including protection plates, both inside and gas casing. (for deposits, traces of boiler compound around man hole doors, wastage, burning, preservation, and external corrosion, particularly at the interface of water drum and gas casing).
All Accessible Tubes Including Super Heater Tubes throughout their Lengths.(for evidence of deposits, corrosion, overheating, deformation, fouling and indentation/dent marks).
Tube Roots Including those of Super Heater Tubes.(for nature and extent of deposits, signs of any leakage and external corrosion / wastage).
Accessible superheater tube supports and clamps(for damage, wear/ tear. Securing of fastening and adequacy of support to tubes).
Economiser Elements. (for corrosion, fire damage, wear/tear and accumulation of deposits, particularly at tube bends).

(a) Boiler Mountings.(for soundness of accessible fasteners and ease of operation from local/remote positions, as applicable).

(b) Direct Reading Water Level Indicators and IGEMA. (for completeness, illumination, cleanliness of glasses, ease of operation and comparison).

(c) Safety Valves. (for completeness of hand easing gear, drain pipes, locking arrangement, seals and tally).

(a) Blow Down Valves/ cocks (for correctness of operating key interlocks and state of insulation).

(b) Blow Down and Super Heater Drain System Pipes. (for corrosion, preservation and state of insulation).

(a) Combustion Registers. (for cleanliness of air, fuel and atomising steam handling components including sighting ports, damages, loose fit, ease of operation).

(b) Alignment of burner/ atomizer swirlier/ quarl (final alignment readings recorded after correction of misalignment, if any be attached with this report).

(a)Soot Blowers. (for cleanliness of air, fuel and atomizing steam handling components including sighting ports, damages, loose fit, correctness of direction of air swirl and ease of operation).

(b)Soot blower nozzle pipe elements (for securing of pipe coupling and ball joint/ supporting brackets/ apertures in centre division wall, fouling and wear/tear).

(c)Alignment of nozzles (jets) of pipe elements and pointer fitted on soot blower valve assembly.

(d) Correctness of blowing arc (sweep angle) (final blowing arc reading recorded after necessary adjustments be attached with this report).
Superheat control dampers (for ease of operation, obstruction, flap fit, serviceability of interlock and alignment of damper with indicators both pneumatic and mechanical).

Water Drum and side water wall header supporting stools and sliding feet (for security, expansion clearances, serviceability of expansion indicators/ greasing arrangement and corrosion/ damage/ preservation).

(a) FD fan inlet gratings and trunking/air space. (for security, obstruction and serviceability of drainage arrangement).

(b) Combustion air supply trunking.(for leakage, lagging, wear/tear, security of supports and obstruction).

(c) Self-closing shutters. (for cleanliness and ease of operation from both local and remote positions).

(d)Lighting up fan flap and Levers of boiler room ventilation air supply trunking.(for wear/tear and serviceability).

(a)Air and Gas Casings. (for corrosion, signs of overheating, distortion, crack, preservation, leakage, serviceability of jointing, security of tie bars/ stiffeners and possible accumulation of deposits, oil and water).

(b)Pumping out arrangement of boiler air casing space.(for wear/tear and serviceability).

(c)Boiler air casing space firefighting arrangements.(for wear/tear and serviceability).

(d)Brick pan underside.(for corrosion, overheating, deformation, security of tie bars/ stiffeners and preservation).

(e)Air cross-over flaps.(for flap fit, cleanliness of flap box, lubrication, ease of operation, effectiveness of locking arrangement and open/shut tallies).

(f)Superheater closing plates, diamond and access doors.(for distortion, leakage, securing arrangement and refractory lining wear).

(a)Uptake and Inner/Outer Funnel Plating, Gratings, Ladders and Access Doors.(for deterioration, damage, deposits, preservation and signs of high temperatures).

(b)Expansion Joints.(for freedom of movement and gas tightness).
Rain Catchment Troughs, Pipe System and Strainers.(for wear/tear and freedom from chokage).
Funnel Cover.(for condition and serviceability of securing arrangement).

(a)Furnace brickwork, refractory, plastic chrome ore walls, upper and lower corners, superheater support protection screen, header cappings, corner fillets, register quarls etc.(for deterioration, damage, crack, spalling and lagging).

(b)Front and rear insulating cladding panels.(for wear/tear and damage).

(c)Economizer cladding panels.(for wear/tear and damage).

(d)Downcomers and uprisers(for state of insulation).
Furnace Floor Drain System.(for wear/ tear and freedom from chokage).
Furnace Observation Windows and Operating Mechanism.(for ease of operation, cleanliness of glasses and leakage).
Boiler Water Sampling System.(for corrosion, preservation and serviceability).
Boiler Dosing System.(for corrosion, preservation and serviceability).

(a)Smoke observation periscope(for cleanliness of glass/ port and serviceability).

(b) Radio visor Funnel Smoke Density Indicator.(for cleanliness of indicator ports and serviceability of indicator lamps/equipments).
Flame In/Out Indicator.(for cleanliness of glass/ port and serviceability).

Boiler Instrumentation.(pressure/ temperature gauges and manometers, fitted on/near boiler front and on boiler control panels for completeness and serviceability including ERCR/PDCR/SPDCR.Attach details on separate sheet, if available space is inadequate).
Torch Igniters.(for cleanliness of connector and serviceability /stowage arrangement).

PART - III

30. General Remarks by Ship.

(To include any other information in addition to that given earlier which may be considered necessary to enable a more complete estimate to be formed of the state of the boiler, e.g., improper combustion, flame characteristics, frequent fouling of burner filters, incidents of boiler pulsation, performance of gauge glasses/Igema and feed regulator, limitation in maintaining superheated steam temperature, abnormal air/flue gas leaks, accessibility for ease of operation and maintenance, long-outstanding defects/deficiencies, recurring defects/erratic performance, and any other abnormality being experienced etc).
